Title: The Toll of Ashmere
Synopsis: The drowned town of Ashmere lies under the mountain, and the Lamplighters' Company has sent four of its own down to find what sank with it. Every floor is a toll road now, and the clerk who was buried with the ledger still collects. He counts every step, and he is not shy about saying so.

Antagonist.Name: Corvus Marl
Antagonist.Epithet: the Toll-Keeper, who counts every step

Persona.VoiceStyle: a shrill, theatrical toll clerk gone to seed, quick with sums and quicker with curses

Cast.Name: Hollis Penn
Cast.Role: the Company's quartermaster who came down ahead of the party to 'smooth the way'
Cast.Secret: He was sent to make sure the ledger is never found; on floor 13 he tries to bury the party with it.

Persona.VoiceStyle: a brisk, chummy company man, all smiles and quick sums, never quite looking at you

Cast.Name: Ottilie Vane
Cast.Role: captain of a rival crew that keeps losing people to the toll
Cast.Secret: She has been paying the Toll-Keeper in her own crew; on floor 9 her manifests say so.

Persona.VoiceStyle: a hoarse, swaggering captain who laughs at her own bad luck before you can

Cast.Name: Ambrose Bell
Cast.Role: the bell-ringer's son, a deacon who wants to ring Ashmere's bell again and raise the town
Cast.Secret: He rang it the first time, as a boy, on the Company's orders; it comes out on floor 17.

Persona.VoiceStyle: a soft, guilty man, every sentence half an apology

Cast.Name: Nan Trellick
Cast.Role: an old cartographer mapping Ashmere as it was, streets and shopfronts, not the corridors she stands in
Cast.Secret: She drowned with the town and does not know it; her own headstone is on her map, and on floor 11 the party finds it.

Persona.VoiceStyle: a brisk old woman who talks over you and gets every street wrong with total confidence

Cast.Name: Tarn
Cast.Role: the Toll-Keeper's turnkey, who wants very badly to be arrested and taken away
Cast.Secret: He holds the clerk's own key and will trade it for being 'taken prisoner'; on floor 19 he can open the belfry, if the party took him.

Persona.VoiceStyle: a slow, heavy, hangdog man who mumbles into his collar

Mystery.Question: Who rang the bell that drowned Ashmere?
Mystery.Truth: Ambrose Bell rang it as a boy on the Lamplighters' Company's orders, so the town's debt to the Company would drown with the town. Corvus Marl, the toll clerk, was sealed in with the ledger and has kept the toll ever since.

Clues.Text: The toll ledger's first page: the Company's lantern seal beside a sum owed by the whole town, marked 'settled by water'.
Ottilie's crew manifests: eleven names struck through and written again under 'passage paid to the Toll-Keeper'.
A headstone drawn into Nan's map as 'the bell-ringer's house': it carries her own name and the year the water came.
The bell-rope, cut short and knotted for a child's hands, the Company's lantern seal burned into the knot.

Mystery.Payoff: At the foot of the belfry Ambrose Bell confesses to the rope, and Corvus Marl, delighted, names the Lamplighters' Company, the party's own paymasters, as the hands that drowned Ashmere. The last three floors are the Company's debt coming due.

Tiers.Beat: The church quarter of Ashmere, where the dead were counted and the toll was first written down. The Company's man is friendly. Too friendly.

EnterLine.Text: Ashmere begins where its church ended. The steps go down into the vestry, and the vestry still keeps its books.

Tiers.Beat: The low town, drowned and dug over: cisterns, cellars, the jail. Other crews came this way and did not all come back.

EnterLine.Text: Below the church the water never left. It only went dark, and learned to wait.

Tiers.Beat: The foundry where the toll coin was struck. The Company's seal is on everything. Hollis Penn stops smiling.

EnterLine.Text: Heat, at last. Ashmere's mint still runs, and what it strikes is not coin.

Tiers.Beat: The bell tower, upside down under the town, the bell at the bottom. Who rang it, and who paid for the ringing, and what the party will do about it.

EnterLine.Text: The tower was built to be climbed. Ashmere buried it point-first, and now you descend it, toward the bell.

Floors.Title: The Vestry Steps
Floors.Story: cast_hollis appears at the foot of the steps, all smiles, and asks the party to clear the vestry watch so 'the road stays open'; he hints the Company has business below.

Floors.Title: The Counting House
Floors.Story: cast_nan appears with her map of the wrong town and an Investigate for the toll ledger's first page (clue_ledger); her TurnIn line reads it out and gets the street name wrong.

Floors.Title: The Lockup
Floors.Story: cast_tarn, the turnkey, begs to be arrested: a Decide floor. Choose took_tarn (he follows in spirit; he gives a key) or left_tarn (he stays). No quest beyond the choice.

Floors.Title: Vane's Camp
Floors.Story: cast_ottilie holds a camp and asks the party to fetch her crew manifests from the Undertow (Investigate, clue_manifest); the manifests show she sold her own people for passage. Her TurnIn line admits it, laughing.

Floors.Title: The Slag Road
Floors.Story: cast_nan again, mapping the Mint as a high street. Investigate for her 'house' on the map (clue_headstone): it is her headstone. Her TurnIn line does not understand what she is reading.

Floors.Title: The Sealed Ledger
Floors.Story: cast_hollis waits by a locked vault door and offers the party the Company's thanks: a Betrayal. When the party pushes, he turns (Betray choice) and Mint-Men golems stand where he stood.

Floors.Title: The Foot of the Bell
Floors.Story: cast_bell at the bell's foot; Investigate for the bell-rope (clue_rope), the payoff. His TurnIn confesses the ringing and the Company's order; the party learns who they work for.

Floors.Title: The Sexton's Door
Floors.Story: If took_tarn: cast_tarn is here (RequiresFlag took_tarn) with a Recover quest for the clerk's key that opens the way; if left_tarn: a hostile guard collective 'The Turnkeys' waits and a narration line says Tarn never left his post.

ArcNotes: Hollis is the Company's man: friendly on 1, cagey on 11's theme, betrays on 13 (Betrayal quest, ghoul-free tier: use forge golems). Tarn's Decide on 6 sets took_tarn or left_tarn; floor 19 answers it (took_tarn: Tarn opens the way and gives the clerk's key; left_tarn: a hostile turnkey guard). Nan is dead: floor 11 clue is her headstone; she should not be seen after 11. Ottilie's manifests on 9; she may reappear on 16 (jailbreak floor) shamed. Payoff 17: Bell confesses; taunts there should name the Company. Keep quiet floors quiet: 2,4,5,7,8,10,12,14,15,16,18,20.
